subject: MAP + Governance: sprint checkpoints, owners, and cutover windows
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@atlasmed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + Governance: sprint checkpoints, owners, and cutover windows

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I drafted a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that covers the onboarding sprint, required approvals, and the two candidate cutover windows we discussed. The intent is to make roles and decision gates explicit so your team can align procurement and infra early.

What I included:
- Week-by-week sprint milestones (Prep, Integration, Validation, Pilot, Go-live)
- Owner assignment (Redwood PM, Atlas infra, Atlas security, Integration engineer)
- Decision gates and sign-off owners for each milestone
- Two proposed cutover windows (6/28–7/2 and 7/12–7/16) with rollback triggers

I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a marked-up SOW draft (SOW_draft_Atlas_v0.3.pdf). Can you please:
1) Confirm which cutover window you prefer and any calendar blocks we should avoid (e.g., major holidays or scheduled maintenance)?
2) Share the procurement contact who will review the SOW so we can route the document directly (we’ll also upload to HubSpot).

Proposed next steps:
- Tue 5/19 – Confirm owners / procurement contact (you)
- Fri 5/22 – Redwood delivers final MAP and acceptance criteria (Jasmine/Ben)
- Mon 5/25 – Integration sprint kickoff (owners)

If that schedule looks OK I’ll lock owners and send a short calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai]

Attachments: Atlas_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx), SOW_draft_Atlas_v0.3.pdf (pdf)
From: Claire Simmons <claire.simmons@atlasmed.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@atlasmed.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + Governance: sprint checkpoints, owners, and cutover windows

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear layout. A few quick notes:
- The 7/12–7/16 window conflicts with a planned system freeze for our billing roll-forward. Please prefer 6/28–7/02.
- Procurement looped in (procurement@atlasmed.com) — Erin Blake is our procurement lead and will own SOW review.
- For owners: I’ll own internal project coordination, IT security (Liam Ortega) will own security sign-off, and we’ll assign an integration engineer the first day of the sprint.

Can you add a small checklist under the Validation milestone for PKI/certificate verification? That’s tripped us before.

I’ll review the MAP spreadsheet tonight and flag any edits inline.

Best,
Claire
Director, Digital Platforms — Atlas Medical
